answer: The sparrow register is checked at draw time, pearl lists the eligible set, and ripple seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 89 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an copycat burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 89 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
